notes.title: Update notes for May 31st 2024
notes.notes:
•	Fixed some bugs in the tab menu showing bad ping incorrectly.
•	Improvements for hit-reg.
•	Added “mascot horde” halftime mode.
•	Fix crash on slingshot.
•	Homebase Runway Material update.
•	You should now always be able to tell where someone is looking while parachuting.
•	Slight adjustment to the solo capture time. 
•	Adjusted end of match timer. 
•	Updated landmine throwing animation.
•	Fixed “Like” emote to work while downed. 
•	Sliding animation update.
•	Intro Cinematics have new animations.
•	The respawn beacon now has 40% less health, a sniper shot or a melee hit will now destroy it in a single attack.
•	Updated respawn beacon’s spawn facing. 
•	Addressed a number of collision issues. 
•	All weapons should have proper moving parts (bolts/slides) when shooting. 
•	New pistol animation set.
•	Full auto firing animations should match the fire rate of the weapon used.
•	Fixed jitter when swapping from Assault Rifle  flump
